essence: Contact with food in that context requires abstention from eating and compensatory recitation.
The prescribed recitation count decreases by half for womb-born beings and by half again for earth-born beings.
A disciplined practitioner with a Shiva-centered mind is enjoined to perform five hundred thousand recitations.
Restrained recitation of five hundred thousand times leads to mastery over the senses.
Midnight recitation brings one close to the attainment of Brahman.
